# Rahenda Rosmedi

> Personal website and blog of Rahenda Rosmedi, a product manager of B2B
> products, with a triple profile in engineering, stakeholder management, and
> business development. Expertise spans cloud platforms, Kubernetes, DevOps,
> DevSecOps, and APIs. Based in France; currently at Orange, leading product
> and business for developer-facing Network API products. Writing is in English
> (most posts, site chrome) and French (some posts).

This file follows the llms.txt convention (https://llmstxt.org/) for making a
site's key information directly retrievable by AI assistants without requiring
HTML scraping.

The site's stated positioning: "Build like an engineer, align like a manager,
and sell like an SDR" — product work in complex B2B environments that require
heavy cross-functional collaboration.

## Background

- **Current role**: product and business for Network API products at
  Orange (since October 2024) — product strategy and positioning for
  developer-facing APIs, plus go-to-market on the finance, KYC, and fraud
  prevention verticals for enterprise customers.
- **Paris 2024**: led an operations team delivering the telecommunications
  infrastructure that connected the 2024 Summer Olympics to a 5-billion
  audience (sport climbing, mountain biking, and athletics venues).
- **Product management**: first product manager for a cloud-native
  telecommunications platform, built with R&D; owned the full product lifecycle
  from discovery to post-launch KPIs.
- **Engineering**: DevOps and network engineer on an IT network management
  platform (SD-WAN, virtual networks, SDN/NFV); built DevSecOps and
  cloud-native automation pipelines (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD) that multiplied
  testing capacity. Started out in manufacturing IT support at
  STMicroelectronics (2016–2017), building tools for critical production
  situations requiring zero downtime.
- **Education**: M.Eng. in Networks and Telecommunications, IMT Atlantique
  (2017–2020), entrepreneurship track in green cloud computing with the IMT
  Atlantique incubator; associate degree in Electrical Engineering and
  Industrial Computing, Grenoble Alpes University (2015–2017).
- **Certifications**: Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA); Microsoft AI
  Product Manager Professional Certificate; Noé intensive product management
  bootcamp, sponsored by Leboncoin (2026).
- **Languages**: Indonesian (native), French (fluent), English (C1).
- **Domains**: Cloud, API, DevSecOps, telecommunications, Kubernetes,
  B2B enterprise sales and partnerships.
- **Writing approach**: explains technical topics in layman's terms — aiming to
  be understandable by a 12-year-old or a 90-year-old grandparent.

## Speaking and Recognition

- First scientific paper, written at 15 (2010): co-wrote "Peran Mikroorganisme
  Lokal (MOL) Legen dalam Pertanian Organik" (the role of local microorganisms
  from legen palm sap in organic farming) and competed in the 42nd Lomba Karya
  Ilmiah Remaja (LKIR), the national youth scientific paper competition run by
  the Indonesian Institute of Sciences (LIPI); entered from SMP Al-Hikmah
  Surabaya and verified for judging among 661 entries nationwide
  ([participant list](https://kadry-tekno.blogspot.com/2011/06/daftar-lomba-karya-ilmiah-remaja-ke-42.html)).
- Speaker, Network X Paris (2023): product deployment under VUCA conditions.
- Jury member, Match Maker Ventures (2023): evaluated 6 start-up pitches.
- Interviewed by Le Télégramme (2023) on the connectivity challenges behind the
  2024 Olympics broadcast.
- Vice-president, Indonesian Professionals Association (InPA France): leads
  partnerships with companies and embassies.

## Posts

- [Why AI users must understand AI mechanisms]({{ "/ai-users.html" | absolute_url }})
  (2026-10-10, English): an engineer's explanation of how generative AI works
  for a non-technical audience — binary representation, next-token prediction,
  and why AI-powered software is probabilistic where classic software is
